Thread-read: 7078042821
Premise: holds — measured by #36299's dev at 7b9e229b (report 7077650228: search 'Row 7', open, close ⇒ the refetch has no `$search`); at origin/main 87c7bbaf `ObjectDataPage.tsx:567` still says "Deliberately NO onSortChange/onFilterChange persistence hooks" and the file never calls `useObjectViewListUrlState`.
Design point (card's "settle first"), settled here as execution, not a product call — it follows ObjectView's existing two-layer address, no new spelling: `filter[...]` stays what it is today, the page's own address conditions (visible removable chips, the source-trail reset, what "Save as view" persists); the Filter panel's conditions go to `uf__filter`, exactly as ObjectView keeps them on top of its view filter. The two are separate layers, AND-ed as ListView already ANDs a view filter and the panel, so neither "wins"; editing one never rewrites the other. Search, sort and grouping use `uf__search` / `uf__sort` / `uf__group`. `resetToSource` already clears every `uf_`-prefixed key. "Save as view" keeps persisting only `filter[...]` (unchanged here). If the dev measures a case where the two layers conflict, it stops and reports rather than picks.
Pre-claim lane: `ui/packages/app-shell/**` is `domain:ui`, this seat's `repo:objectstack` intake; dispatched by seat order 22:30Z (Steve 「派」 22:29Z, area:ux p2 without a topic parent).
